question: A, B, C, D, E and F live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. D lives on an odd numbered floor but not on floor number 3. Only two people live between D and A. C lives immediately above A. Only two people live between C and B. F lives on one of the floors below B but not on the lowermost floor. Who lives on floor number 4?
